inlines.v: SEE'MLY, adjective. Becoming; fit; suited to the object, occasion, purpose or character; suitable. Suspense of judgement and excercise of charity were safer and seemlier for christian men, than the hot pursuit of these controversies. Hooker. Honor is not seemly for a fool. Proverbs 26:1. SEE'MLY, adv. In a decent or suitable manner.
